values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/genespond ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Gene's Pond State Forest Campground: 14 sites, $20), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Campground and seasonal roads are not plowed in winter.

season.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/genespond ('This rustic campground is open all year; however, the campground and seasonal roads are not plowed.') + amenity table (Gene's Pond: 'open all year'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Boat launch on the pond with a large parking area for vehicles and boat trailers; carry-in access about 50 yards from the parking area. Carry-in, carry-out: no trash barrels (refuse goes to the dumpsters at the Gwinn Field Office).

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/genespond ('There are vault toilets.' 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well.' 'A boat launch is located on Gene's Pond.' 'This is a "carry-in, carry-out" unit. Trash barrels are not provided.'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/genespond ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis.' 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay.') + amenity table ('Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com': no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: '14 sites for tent, small trailer and large trailer use' (no maximum length posted). One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/genespond ('There are 14 sites for tent, small trailer and large trailer use'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + amenity table (14 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic state forest campground shaded by upland hardwoods on Gene's Pond (bass, pike, walleye, panfish), 6.5 miles northwest of Felch via County Roads 581 and 422, Dickinson County; a quiet retreat. Pickerel Lake 3 miles northeast. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 14 sites (tent, small and large trailer), $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, boat launch, first-come only, open all year (roads not plowed) - all confirmed. Changed max stay 14 -> 15 nights. Note corrected (it said ~$15/night and a 14-day limit) and trimmed of field restatements. Second website link superseded (flag); phones differ between the DNR's own pages (flag).
